title: Bookings
description: When guests book and how full the tables are. Times are Asia/Tbilisi; the time axis is the booking's start.

list.name: location
list.label: Location
list.query: SELECT address AS __text, id AS __value FROM locations ORDER BY created_at
list.definition: SELECT address AS __text, id AS __value FROM locations ORDER BY created_at

panels.title: Bookings per day
panels.description: Bookings by the day they start, confirmed and cancelled apart.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', b.starts_at, 'Asia/Tbilisi') AS time,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.status = 'CONFIRMED') AS "Confirmed",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.status = 'CANCELLED') AS "Cancelled"
FROM bookings b
JOIN dining_tables t ON t.id = b.table_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(b.starts_at)
  AND b.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'CANCELLED')
  AND t.location_id IN ($location)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Cancellation rate
panels.description: Cancelled bookings over confirmed plus cancelled ones that start in the range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.status = 'CANCELLED')::float / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS "Cancellation rate"
FROM bookings b
JOIN dining_tables t ON t.id = b.table_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(b.starts_at)
  AND b.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'CANCELLED')
  AND t.location_id IN ($location)

panels.title: Occupancy per location
panels.description: Booked table time of confirmed bookings over the tables' open time, 10:00 to 23:00 on each day of the range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS range_from, $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS range_to
), open_days AS (
  SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('day', range_from, 'Asia/Tbilisi'), range_to, interval '1 day') AS day
  FROM bounds
), open_time AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(sum(extract(epoch FROM GREATEST(
           LEAST(day + interval '23 hours', range_to) - GREATEST(day + interval '10 hours', range_from),
           interval '0'
         ))), 0) AS seconds_per_table
  FROM open_days, bounds
), booked AS (
  SELECT t.location_id, sum(extract(epoch FROM b.ends_at - b.starts_at)) AS seconds
  FROM bookings b
  JOIN dining_tables t ON t.id = b.table_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(b.starts_at)
    AND b.status = 'CONFIRMED'
  GROUP BY t.location_id
), seats AS (
  SELECT location_id, count(*) AS tables
  FROM dining_tables
  GROUP BY location_id
)
SELECT l.address AS "Location",
       (COALESCE(booked.seconds, 0) / NULLIF(seats.tables * open_time.seconds_per_table, 0))::float AS "Occupancy"
FROM locations l
JOIN seats ON seats.location_id = l.id
LEFT JOIN booked ON booked.location_id = l.id
CROSS JOIN open_time
WHERE l.id IN ($location)
ORDER BY l.created_at

panels.title: Heatmap weekday × start hour
panels.description: Confirmed bookings by the weekday and the hour they start.

targets.rawSql:
WITH visits AS (
  SELECT extract(isodow FROM b.starts_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tbilisi')::int AS weekday,
         extract(hour FROM b.starts_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tbilisi')::int AS hour
  FROM bookings b
  JOIN dining_tables t ON t.id = b.table_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(b.starts_at)
    AND b.status = 'CONFIRMED'
    AND t.location_id IN ($location)
)
SELECT (ARRAY['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'])[d.weekday] AS "Weekday",
       count(v.hour) FILTER (WHERE v.hour = 10) AS "10:00",
       count(v.hour) FILTER (WHERE v.hour = 11) AS "11:00",
       count(v.hour) FILTER (WHERE v.hour = 12) AS "12:00",
       count(v.hour) FILTER (WHERE v.hour = 13) AS "13:00",
       count(v.hour) FILTER (WHERE v.hour = 14) AS "14:00",
       count(v.hour) FILTER (WHERE v.hour = 15) AS "15:00",
       count(v.hour) FILTER (WHERE v.hour = 16) AS "16:00",
       count(v.hour) FILTER (WHERE v.hour = 17) AS "17:00",
       count(v.hour) FILTER (WHERE v.hour = 18) AS "18:00",
       count(v.hour) FILTER (WHERE v.hour = 19) AS "19:00",
       count(v.hour) FILTER (WHERE v.hour = 20) AS "20:00",
       count(v.hour) FILTER (WHERE v.hour = 21) AS "21:00"
FROM generate_series(1, 7) AS d (weekday)
LEFT JOIN visits v ON v.weekday = d.weekday
GROUP BY d.weekday
ORDER BY d.weekday

panels.title: Lead time distribution
panels.description: Confirmed bookings by the number of days between booking and visit.

targets.rawSql:
WITH visits AS (
  SELECT (b.starts_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tbilisi')::date - (b.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tbilisi')::date AS days_ahead
  FROM bookings b
  JOIN dining_tables t ON t.id = b.table_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(b.starts_at)
    AND b.status = 'CONFIRMED'
    AND t.location_id IN ($location)
)
SELECT CASE d.days_ahead WHEN 0 THEN 'same day' WHEN 1 THEN '1 day' ELSE d.days_ahead || ' days' END AS "Booked ahead",
       count(v.days_ahead) AS "Visits"
FROM generate_series(0, (SELECT max(days_ahead) FROM visits)) AS d (days_ahead)
LEFT JOIN visits v ON v.days_ahead = d.days_ahead
GROUP BY d.days_ahead
ORDER BY d.days_ahead
